path.description: Absolute path on the selected Environment's file system of the text file to edit. It must be a regular text file: directories, devices, FIFOs and binary files are rejected before any write. Relative paths are rejected.

edits.description: One or more independent exact replacements, all matched and validated against the original file content. A replacement that is unchanged after newline normalization is allowed alongside other changes but is skipped when applying the edits. Use one entry for a single change.

old_string.description: Exact non-empty text to replace. It must match the original file content exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: Replacement text. It may be empty to delete the matched text, or unchanged after newline normalization; unchanged replacements are still validated and counted but not applied.

replace_all.description: Replace every exact occurrence of old_string. Defaults to false.
